'''2012 European Championship Marc Nickels DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Marc Nickels]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]
* '''Username:''' Darkbow
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
